title: How $1,000 Became $1.16 MILLION… Buying Just 1 Stock a Year
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: Buying the prior year's top S&P 500 performer(s) with a weekly-close 30% stop beats the index; he prefers the top-3 version.
Outsized recent winner returns echo the late-1990s and suggest a late bull market, 'eighth and ninth inning of this AI bubble'.

calls.reason: Huge top-performer returns in 2024-2026 resemble 1997-99 ahead of the dot-com peak; says we are in the 8th-9th inning of the AI bubble.
calls.quote: this tends to be what we see toward the end of a bull market peak.

notes: Mostly a backtest/education video; no stock picks for the coming year. The only market view is a vague late-cycle warning, recorded as low-conviction long-term bearish ES.
